tasks.label: 🗄️ Start MongoDB
tasks.command: docker start ai-marketing-agent-mongo-1 2>/dev/null && echo '✅ MongoDB started' || (echo '📦 MongoDB container not found, creating...' && cd "${workspaceFolder}" && docker run -d --name ai-marketing-agent-mongo-1 -p 27017:27017 -v ai-marketing-agent-mongo-data:/data/db mongo:4.4 && echo '✅ MongoDB created and started')

tasks.label: ⚙️ Start Backend (API Server)
tasks.command: echo '⏳ Starting backend API server...' && echo '🔍 Checking port 8088...' && (lsof -ti:8088 2>/dev/null | xargs -r kill -9 2>/dev/null && echo '🧹 Killed existing process on port 8088' || echo '✓ Port 8088 is free') && sleep 2 && cd "${workspaceFolder}" && uvicorn app.main:api_app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8088 --reload

tasks.label: 🎨 Start Frontend (Next.js)
tasks.command: echo '⏳ Starting frontend server...' && echo '🔍 Checking port 3001...' && (lsof -ti:3001 2>/dev/null | xargs -r kill -9 2>/dev/null && echo '🧹 Killed existing process on port 3001' || echo '✓ Port 3001 is free') && sleep 2 && cd "${workspaceFolder}/frontend" && npm run dev

tasks.label: 🛑 Stop All Services
tasks.command: echo '🛑 Stopping all services...' && echo '' && echo '⚙️  Backend API:' && (ps aux | grep -E '[u]vicorn app.main' | awk '{print $2}' | xargs -r kill -9 2>/dev/null && echo '   ✅ Stopped' || echo '   ⚪ Already stopped') && echo '' && echo '🎨 Frontend:' && (ps aux | grep -E '[n]ext dev' | awk '{print $2}' | xargs -r kill -9 2>/dev/null && echo '   ✅ Stopped' || echo '   ⚪ Already stopped') && echo '' && echo '🗄️  MongoDB:' && (docker stop ai-marketing-agent-mongo-1 2>/dev/null && echo '   ✅ Stopped' || echo '   ⚪ Already stopped') && echo '' && echo '════════════════════════════════════════' && echo '✅ Stop command completed'

tasks.label: 📊 Check Services Status
tasks.command: echo '═══════════════════════════════════════' && echo '📊 Services Status Check' && echo '═══════════════════════════════════════' && echo '' && echo '🗄️  MongoDB Container:' && (docker ps --format '{{.Names}} - {{.Status}}' | grep ai-marketing-agent-mongo-1 && echo '   ✅ Running' || echo '   ❌ Stopped') && echo '' && echo '⚙️  Backend API (Port 8088):' && (pgrep -f 'uvicorn app.main' > /dev/null && echo '   ✅ Running (PID: '$(pgrep -f 'uvicorn app.main')')' || echo '   ❌ Stopped') && echo '' && echo '🎨 Frontend (Port 3001):' && (pgrep -f 'next dev' > /dev/null && echo '   ✅ Running (PID: '$(pgrep -f 'next dev')')' || echo '   ❌ Stopped') && echo '' && echo '═══════════════════════════════════════'

tasks.label: 🗄️ Stop MongoDB
tasks.command: docker stop ai-marketing-agent-mongo-1 && echo '✅ MongoDB stopped'

tasks.label: 🔄 Restart MongoDB
tasks.command: docker restart ai-marketing-agent-mongo-1 && echo '✅ MongoDB restarted'

tasks.label: 📊 MongoDB Health Check
tasks.command: echo '🔍 Checking MongoDB health...' && docker exec ai-marketing-agent-mongo-1 mongosh --eval 'db.adminCommand("ping")' --quiet && echo '✅ MongoDB is healthy'

tasks.label: 🧹 Clean Logs
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && rm -f api_server.log frontend_server.log && echo '✅ Logs cleaned (api_server.log, frontend_server.log)'

tasks.label: 🔍 View Backend Logs
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && echo '📄 Backend API Logs (api_server.log):' && echo '════════════════════════════════════════════════' && tail -50 api_server.log 2>/dev/null || echo '❌ Log file not found. Backend may not be running yet.'

tasks.label: 🔍 View Frontend Logs
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && echo '📄 Frontend Logs (frontend_server.log):' && echo '════════════════════════════════════════════════' && tail -50 frontend_server.log 2>/dev/null || echo '❌ Log file not found. Frontend may not be running yet.'
